meta.name: folklore-variant-evidence
meta.description: Retrieves ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and reviews source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Used when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence provenance without accepting patient, phenotype, family, segregation, or private case data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查清某个基因变异是否有公开文献与临床证据支持
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做遗传变异解读,需要快速核对公开证据与文献来源。
copy.tagline_en: Check whether a gene variant is backed by public clinical evidence and literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you interpret genetic variants and must verify public evidence and sources fast

howto.what: 通过 Folklore MCP 查询公共基因或疾病的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言,并对单个 GRCh38 胚系 SNV 或简单 indel 检索带来源的公共证据与文献;按 resolved、ambiguous 等返回状态分别处理,拒绝患者、表型、家系等私有数据。
howto.when: 当你要把某个公共变异查成带来源的结构化证据、按解析状态分支处理,或查询 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言时接管。

say.text: 用 GRCh38 查一下 rs80357914 的公共变异证据
say.note: 返回状态;若为 ambiguous 会停下等你选择

say.text: 把刚解析出的变异 canonical_key 关联到相关文献
say.note: 会检索与该变异相关的文献

say.text: 查一下 BRCA1 的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言
say.note: 返回疾病、遗传方式与来源链接

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Folklore MCP to fetch ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and source-linked evidence plus literature for one GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel, branching on returned statuses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a public variant turned into source-linked structured evidence, status-based branching, or ClinGen gene-disease assertions.

say_en.text: Look up the public variant evidence for rs80357914 on GRCh38.
say_en.note: Returns a status; if ambiguous it stops for your choice.

say_en.text: Chain that variant's canonical_key into variant-linked literature.
say_en.note: Searches literature tied to the resolved variant.

say_en.text: Show ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for BRCA1.
say_en.note: Returns diseases, inheritance, and source links.
